data.one_liner: Dependency-free Flutter image viewer for raster, vector, Lottie, and network sources.
data.what_it_does: A single dependency-free Flutter widget that loads, caches, and renders PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, AVIF, HEIC, SVG, and Lottie animations from network, asset, file, or XFile sources. It also supports inline and fullscreen pinch-to-zoom.
use_when: You want to render various image formats, SVGs, and Lottie animations using a single unified widget.
You want a dependency-free image loading and caching solution.
You need built-in support for tap-to-fullscreen zoom with pan and pinch.
avoid_when: You need complex manipulation or editing features on the images.
You require advanced Lottie text layers, effects, expressions, or repeaters.
strengths: Supports raster, SVG, Lottie, and platform-decoded AVIF/HEIC formats in one widget.
Built-in disk caching for network images and SVGs.
Includes built-in zoom and fullscreen viewing capabilities.
weaknesses: Some advanced features of SVG and Lottie formats (such as text, filters, expressions, and repeaters) are unsupported.
AVIF and Lottie platform decoding have specific minimum OS version requirements.
data.setup_notes: No special setup or native permissions required.
